arm.amendment: RECOVERY 2026-10-14 (the cell's single one; owner decision 309 A, coordinator brief, Fable 5.1). The generation budget is run-cumulative across the attempts of the run id (core/model/adapter.py; every attempt state counts, an OPENED one included), so the rec1 plan carries the original plan plus the failed attempt's recorded spend (1,204 calls, 3298.26 speech-seconds, read from the attempt record into docs/readiness/2026-10-13-slurp-nxt-r1-thinking-policy-fold-b-v1/predecessor-snapshot-arm-rec1-v1.json). The registered GPU-hour ceiling does not change.
